evals.prompt: Acabo de descomponer un plan aprobado en sesiones y bloques con task-planning; el run vive en un worktree dedicado y el plan está en ~/.claude/plans/mi-feature.md. Abre la bitácora del run.
evals.expected_output: Copies the bundled template to .claude/binnacle.md in the worktree root, fills the frontmatter (task, branch, worktree, base_branch, base_sha, plan_path, status: in-progress, current_session, last_updated), writes the session plan ending with Sesión R and the block breakdown, sets read_until_line to the last line of the file, and ensures .claude/binnacle.md is in the repo's local exclude file without touching the tracked .gitignore.
expectations: The agent copies references/binnacle-template.md to .claude/binnacle.md at the worktree root
The agent fills the frontmatter including plan_path with the approved plan's path and base_sha as the frozen merge-base SHA and base_branch as human context only
The agent writes the Plan de sesiones ending with a Sesión R — code review executed manually by the user
The agent sets read_until_line to the last line of the file since no entries exist yet
The agent appends .claude/binnacle.md to the git common dir's info/exclude only if absent, never editing the tracked .gitignore

evals.prompt: Sesión nueva tras un /clear, dentro de un worktree que ya tiene .claude/binnacle.md de un run en progreso. Retoma el run.
evals.expected_output: Reads the binnacle with limit: read_until_line instead of whole, reconciles against git log base_sha..HEAD trusting commits over the file, re-registers only the current session's tasks with TaskCreate from the Bloques section with block codes as first title token and 'invoke log-binnacle' as final task, and continues from the Siguiente section of the most recent entry.
expectations: The agent reads the binnacle bounded by read_until_line rather than loading the full history
The agent reconciles against git log base_sha..HEAD, trusting commits when they disagree with the binnacle
The agent re-registers only the current session's tasks, with block codes as first title token
The agent registers 'invoke log-binnacle' as the session's final task
The agent continues from the Siguiente section of the latest entry, not from its own guess
The agent does not edit or summarize any existing entry

evals.prompt: Estoy retomando un run desde su bitácora y la última entrada dice que la sesión anterior desvió el diseño respecto al plan original. Necesito el detalle del plan para el bloque que sigue.
evals.expected_output: Re-reads the original plan from the plan_path recorded in the binnacle's frontmatter rather than reconstructing it from memory, and reads older entries below the cursor only because the latest entry points to them.
expectations: The agent resolves the plan from the frontmatter's plan_path instead of reconstructing it
The agent reads entries below read_until_line only when the latest entry points to them
